meta.title: Sharing The Burden
meta.description: The game is treacherous and ever-shifting and thus reinforcements are essential.

units.rawText: The Oasis, Ops Room.
units.displayText: The Oasis, Ops Room.

spans.text: The Oasis, Ops Room.

units.rawText: The stagnating air in the room weighs down on Persicaria, making every syllable a struggle.
units.displayText: The stagnating air in the room weighs down on Persicaria, making every syllable a struggle.

spans.text: The stagnating air in the room weighs down on Persicaria, making every syllable a struggle.

units.rawText: With limited personnel, should we assist Horizon in the defense or relieve Hubble in her time of need?
units.displayText: With limited personnel, should we assist Horizon in the defense or relieve Hubble in her time of need?

spans.text: With limited personnel, should we assist Horizon in the defense or relieve Hubble in her time of need?

units.rawText: ...But I don't want to give up either.
units.displayText: ...But I don't want to give up either.

spans.text: ...But I don't want to give up either.

units.rawText: Persicaria, in times like these, giving up neither means giving up both.
units.displayText: Persicaria, in times like these, giving up neither means giving up both.

spans.text: Persicaria, in times like these, giving up neither means giving up both.

units.rawText: No, there has to be a way!
units.displayText: No, there has to be a way!

spans.text: No, there has to be a way!

units.rawText: Horizon, use whatever operands you have left to forcibly reboot Zone G's Sandbox Barrier and re-establish a connection with the Ops Room.
units.displayText: Horizon, use whatever operands you have left to forcibly reboot Zone G's Sandbox Barrier and re-establish a connection with the Ops Room.

spans.text: Horizon, use whatever operands you have left to forcibly reboot Zone G's Sandbox Barrier and re-establish a connection with the Ops Room.

units.rawText: I'll keep the operand usage of other structures to a minimum. So long as the reboot is successful, I'll be able to keep the barrier active!
units.displayText: I'll keep the operand usage of other structures to a minimum. So long as the reboot is successful, I'll be able to keep the barrier active!

spans.text: I'll keep the operand usage of other structures to a minimum. So long as the reboot is successful, I'll be able to keep the barrier active!

units.rawText: That's an idea, but...
units.displayText: That's an idea, but...

spans.text: That's an idea, but...

units.rawText: Regardless of whether the restart will be successful or not, we're already committing all our operands to weathering the assault.
units.displayText: Regardless of whether the restart will be successful or not, we're already committing all our operands to weathering the assault.

spans.text: Regardless of whether the restart will be successful or not, we're already committing all our operands to weathering the assault.

units.rawText: Magnhilda...
units.displayText: Magnhilda...

spans.text: Magnhilda...

units.rawText: With how much pressure they're being put under, they're already barely hanging on.
units.displayText: With how much pressure they're being put under, they're already barely hanging on.

spans.text: With how much pressure they're being put under, they're already barely hanging on.

units.rawText: If we are to cut off our battlefield support, the lines will crumble before the reboot is done!
units.displayText: If we are to cut off our battlefield support, the lines will crumble before the reboot is done!

spans.text: If we are to cut off our battlefield support, the lines will crumble before the reboot is done!

units.rawText: At least... we'll need at least some reinforcements to hold off these Entropics while we get the reboot underway. There might be a chance then.
units.displayText: At least... we'll need at least some reinforcements to hold off these Entropics while we get the reboot underway. There might be a chance then.

spans.text: At least... we'll need at least some reinforcements to hold off these Entropics while we get the reboot underway. There might be a chance then.

units.rawText: That's the minimum I can ask.
units.displayText: That's the minimum I can ask.

spans.text: That's the minimum I can ask.

units.rawText: ...Daiyan, transfer Hubble's call to me.
units.displayText: ...Daiyan, transfer Hubble's call to me.

spans.text: ...Daiyan, transfer Hubble's call to me.

units.rawText: Understood.
units.displayText: Understood.

spans.text: Understood.

units.rawText: Hubble, what's the minimum amount of reinforcements you can accept?
units.displayText: Hubble, what's the minimum amount of reinforcements you can accept?

spans.text: Hubble, what's the minimum amount of reinforcements you can accept?

units.rawText: An armed detachment of maybe... 20? and a medical squad of 10.
units.displayText: An armed detachment of maybe... 20? and a medical squad of 10.

spans.text: An armed detachment of maybe... 20? and a medical squad of 10.

units.rawText: I heard your previous conversation... but we don't have it any easier here.
units.displayText: I heard your previous conversation... but we don't have it any easier here.

spans.text: I heard your previous conversation... but we don't have it any easier here.

units.rawText: We'll do what we can here, but the data backup center has already sustained heavy losses and the Entropic infection only makes matters worse.
units.displayText: We'll do what we can here, but the data backup center has already sustained heavy losses and the Entropic infection only makes matters worse.

spans.text: We'll do what we can here, but the data backup center has already sustained heavy losses and the Entropic infection only makes matters worse.

units.rawText: Stop wasting time!
units.displayText: Stop wasting time!

spans.text: Stop wasting time!

units.rawText: Fresnel? Are you alright?
units.displayText: Fresnel? Are you alright?

spans.text: Fresnel? Are you alright?

units.rawText: Minor wounds. We'll be fine, Persicaria! Go reinforce them at the barrier! You should know what to do!
units.displayText: Minor wounds. We'll be fine, Persicaria! Go reinforce them at the barrier! You should know what to do!

spans.text: Minor wounds. We'll be fine, Persicaria! Go reinforce them at the barrier! You should know what to do!

units.rawText: If the barrier is taken, then all is lost! There'll be no end to them!
units.displayText: If the barrier is taken, then all is lost! There'll be no end to them!

spans.text: If the barrier is taken, then all is lost! There'll be no end to them!

units.rawText: But right now, Simo and Fresnel... they not only have to repel the Entropic attacks but they also have to control the infection...
units.displayText: But right now, Simo and Fresnel... they not only have to repel the Entropic attacks but they also have to control the infection...

spans.text: But right now, Simo and Fresnel... they not only have to repel the Entropic attacks but they also have to control the infection...

units.rawText: Persicaria!
units.displayText: Persicaria!

spans.text: Persicaria!

units.rawText: An interjecting voice appears, pulling attention to another figure on the screen.
units.displayText: An interjecting voice appears, pulling attention to another figure on the screen.

spans.text: An interjecting voice appears, pulling attention to another figure on the screen.

units.rawText: Persicaria, I know what's happening in the Oasis right now... we'll do our best to endure here.
units.displayText: Persicaria, I know what's happening in the Oasis right now... we'll do our best to endure here.

spans.text: Persicaria, I know what's happening in the Oasis right now... we'll do our best to endure here.

units.rawText: You can't solve these problems with bravado, Simo!
units.displayText: You can't solve these problems with bravado, Simo!

spans.text: You can't solve these problems with bravado, Simo!

units.rawText: Simo's forced composure shatters, and he takes a deep breath.
units.displayText: Simo's forced composure shatters, and he takes a deep breath.

spans.text: Simo's forced composure shatters, and he takes a deep breath.

units.rawText: Behind him was their once-whole home, each and every person in sight on the brink of death.
units.displayText: Behind him was their once-whole home, each and every person in sight on the brink of death.

spans.text: Behind him was their once-whole home, each and every person in sight on the brink of death.

units.rawText: 15... no, 13 should do. That'll be enough.
units.displayText: 15... no, 13 should do. That'll be enough.

spans.text: 15... no, 13 should do. That'll be enough.

units.rawText: If you can't spare anyone, that's alright, too. I'll fight to the last with everyone here.
units.displayText: If you can't spare anyone, that's alright, too. I'll fight to the last with everyone here.

spans.text: If you can't spare anyone, that's alright, too. I'll fight to the last with everyone here.

units.rawText: Simo disappears on the screen. Persicaria clutches her terminal with a vicelike grip, her fingers on the verge of sinking in.
units.displayText: Simo disappears on the screen. Persicaria clutches her terminal with a vicelike grip, her fingers on the verge of sinking in.

spans.text: Simo disappears on the screen. Persicaria clutches her terminal with a vicelike grip, her fingers on the verge of sinking in.

units.rawText: Putting together every available individual in the nearby areas, we'll be able to relieve at least one side. We have no more time, Persicaria.
units.displayText: Putting together every available individual in the nearby areas, we'll be able to relieve at least one side. We have no more time, Persicaria.

spans.text: Putting together every available individual in the nearby areas, we'll be able to relieve at least one side. We have no more time, Persicaria.

units.rawText: A decision has to be made.
units.displayText: A decision has to be made.

spans.text: A decision has to be made.

units.rawText: If the backup center is lost, agents won't be able to be "reset" anymore. Any further sacrifices will mean true "death";
units.displayText: If the backup center is lost, agents won't be able to be "reset" anymore. Any further sacrifices will mean true "death";

spans.text: If the backup center is lost, agents won't be able to be "reset" anymore. Any further sacrifices will mean true "death";

units.rawText: If the Sandbox Barrier is lost, endless enemies will flood in, and the number of sacrifices will only increase.
units.displayText: If the Sandbox Barrier is lost, endless enemies will flood in, and the number of sacrifices will only increase.

spans.text: If the Sandbox Barrier is lost, endless enemies will flood in, and the number of sacrifices will only increase.

units.rawText: On both sides stood stalwart companions, those who have stood with you through the long nights and dark days.
units.displayText: On both sides stood stalwart companions, those who have stood with you through the long nights and dark days.

spans.text: On both sides stood stalwart companions, those who have stood with you through the long nights and dark days.

units.rawText: To save one is to forsake the other.
units.displayText: To save one is to forsake the other.

spans.text: To save one is to forsake the other.

units.rawText: <size=28>If I didn't send anyone for the communications nodes...</size>
units.displayText: If I didn't send anyone for the communications nodes...

spans.text: If I didn't send anyone for the communications nodes...

units.rawText: Beeeeep—
units.displayText: Beeeeep—

spans.text: Beeeeep—

units.rawText: A sharp ringtone pierces the listless air. Persicaria almost subconsciously taps her terminal, instinctively praying for deliverance.
units.displayText: A sharp ringtone pierces the listless air. Persicaria almost subconsciously taps her terminal, instinctively praying for deliverance.

spans.text: A sharp ringtone pierces the listless air. Persicaria almost subconsciously taps her terminal, instinctively praying for deliverance.

units.rawText: It was an abnormally short message, one devoid of any signature, and concluded with a simple symbol.
units.displayText: It was an abnormally short message, one devoid of any signature, and concluded with a simple symbol.

spans.text: It was an abnormally short message, one devoid of any signature, and concluded with a simple symbol.

units.rawText: <size=40>Be there soon.</size>
units.displayText: Be there soon.

spans.text: Be there soon.

units.rawText: That symbol...
units.displayText: That symbol...

spans.text: That symbol...

units.rawText: Hold on, the communications are back?
units.displayText: Hold on, the communications are back?

spans.text: Hold on, the communications are back?

units.rawText: With that firestarter, messages from all directions came rushing in, their sounds akin to a joyous melody.
units.displayText: With that firestarter, messages from all directions came rushing in, their sounds akin to a joyous melody.

spans.text: With that firestarter, messages from all directions came rushing in, their sounds akin to a joyous melody.

units.rawText: The team dispatched to perform the repairs haven't been gone for long... they've completed their assignment nearly three times faster than expected!
units.displayText: The team dispatched to perform the repairs haven't been gone for long... they've completed their assignment nearly three times faster than expected!

spans.text: The team dispatched to perform the repairs haven't been gone for long... they've completed their assignment nearly three times faster than expected!

units.rawText: Thank goodness, we'll be able to contact our expeditionary teams and the Professor now!
units.displayText: Thank goodness, we'll be able to contact our expeditionary teams and the Professor now!

spans.text: Thank goodness, we'll be able to contact our expeditionary teams and the Professor now!

units.rawText: There's a squad heading towards the Oasis right now!
units.displayText: There's a squad heading towards the Oasis right now!

spans.text: There's a squad heading towards the Oasis right now!

units.rawText:
Great!
Daiyan, direct all reserve agents to assist Hubble! Horizon, hold on for just a little bit longer. Outside help is on the way!
units.displayText:
Great!
Daiyan, direct all reserve agents to assist Hubble! Horizon, hold on for just a little bit longer. Outside help is on the way!

spans.text:
Great!
Daiyan, direct all reserve agents to assist Hubble! Horizon, hold on for just a little bit longer. Outside help is on the way!

units.rawText: <size=40>Understood!</size>
units.displayText: Understood!

spans.text: Understood!

units.rawText: Call coming through; it's—
units.displayText: Call coming through; it's—

spans.text: Call coming through; it's—

units.rawText: <size=40>Persicaria!</size> Finally, what's the situation in the Oasis?
units.displayText: Persicaria! Finally, what's the situation in the Oasis?

spans.text: Persicaria!
Finally, what's the situation in the Oasis?

units.rawText: As she eyes on that ever-so-familiar face, tears threatened to overcome Persicaria.
units.displayText: As she eyes on that ever-so-familiar face, tears threatened to overcome Persicaria.

spans.text: As she eyes on that ever-so-familiar face, tears threatened to overcome Persicaria.

units.rawText: ...It's a little complicated. Though it's good to see you again, Sol!
units.displayText: ...It's a little complicated. Though it's good to see you again, Sol!

spans.text: ...It's a little complicated. Though it's good to see you again, Sol!

units.rawText: I've got Anna with me, and we're on the way back!
units.displayText: I've got Anna with me, and we're on the way back!

spans.text: I've got Anna with me, and we're on the way back!

units.rawText: Fantastic, the Oasis has never needed you more. Is the Professor with you?
units.displayText: Fantastic, the Oasis has never needed you more. Is the Professor with you?

spans.text: Fantastic, the Oasis has never needed you more. Is the Professor with you?

units.rawText: Persicaria's heart sinks as she scans for the familiar figure, finding no purchase.
units.displayText: Persicaria's heart sinks as she scans for the familiar figure, finding no purchase.

spans.text: Persicaria's heart sinks as she scans for the familiar figure, finding no purchase.

units.rawText: ...Where's the Professor?
units.displayText: ...Where's the Professor?

spans.text: ...Where's the Professor?

units.rawText: Relax, Prof's fine. They're having some sort of contest with Eucharist. Chess, or whatever... I've no clue, really.
units.displayText: Relax, Prof's fine. They're having some sort of contest with Eucharist. Chess, or whatever... I've no clue, really.

spans.text: Relax, Prof's fine. They're having some sort of contest with Eucharist. Chess, or whatever... I've no clue, really.

units.rawText: The Professor and Eucharist are both engaged. A net positive for us.
units.displayText: The Professor and Eucharist are both engaged. A net positive for us.

spans.text: The Professor and Eucharist are both engaged. A net positive for us.

units.rawText: Engaging Eucharist...?
units.displayText: Engaging Eucharist...?

spans.text: Engaging Eucharist...?

units.rawText: Look, it's not that simple to explain. In any case, Faith from the Sanctifiers is with 'em, so they'll be fine!
units.displayText: Look, it's not that simple to explain. In any case, Faith from the Sanctifiers is with 'em, so they'll be fine!

spans.text: Look, it's not that simple to explain. In any case, Faith from the Sanctifiers is with 'em, so they'll be fine!

units.rawText: Phew, so long as they're safe...
units.displayText: Phew, so long as they're safe...

spans.text: Phew, so long as they're safe...

units.rawText: ...Did the Professor say anything about when they'd be back to the Oasis?
units.displayText: ...Did the Professor say anything about when they'd be back to the Oasis?

spans.text: ...Did the Professor say anything about when they'd be back to the Oasis?

units.rawText: Persicaria looks at Sol with expectation in her eyes as the latter slowly shakes their head.
units.displayText: Persicaria looks at Sol with expectation in her eyes as the latter slowly shakes their head.

spans.text: Persicaria looks at Sol with expectation in her eyes as the latter slowly shakes their head.

units.rawText: We can't make contact with them either. No idea what's going on over there exactly.
units.displayText: We can't make contact with them either. No idea what's going on over there exactly.

spans.text: We can't make contact with them either. No idea what's going on over there exactly.

units.rawText: Back there... getting me and Anna back to the Oasis was the most they could do.
units.displayText: Back there... getting me and Anna back to the Oasis was the most they could do.

spans.text: Back there... getting me and Anna back to the Oasis was the most they could do.

units.rawText: I see... Still, if it weren't for you two and the Professor, I'd be at a loss right now.
units.displayText: I see... Still, if it weren't for you two and the Professor, I'd be at a loss right now.

spans.text: I see... Still, if it weren't for you two and the Professor, I'd be at a loss right now.

units.rawText: Oh yeah, about that. The Prof asked me to convey a message to you.
units.displayText: Oh yeah, about that. The Prof asked me to convey a message to you.

spans.text: Oh yeah, about that. The Prof asked me to convey a message to you.

units.rawText: Sol clears her throat, imitating the Professor's tone.
units.displayText: Sol clears her throat, imitating the Professor's tone.

spans.text: Sol clears her throat, imitating the Professor's tone.

units.rawText: Persicaria, I trust that you'll handle the Oasis appropriately. As you put faith in me, know that I do the same for you.
units.displayText: Persicaria, I trust that you'll handle the Oasis appropriately. As you put faith in me, know that I do the same for you.

spans.text: Persicaria, I trust that you'll handle the Oasis appropriately. As you put faith in me, know that I do the same for you.

units.rawText: Wait for me.
units.displayText: Wait for me.

spans.text: Wait for me.

units.rawText: That's what they said.
units.displayText: That's what they said.

spans.text: That's what they said.

units.rawText: ...I understand.
units.displayText: ...I understand.

spans.text: ...I understand.

units.rawText: Persicaria inhales deeply.
units.displayText: Persicaria inhales deeply.

spans.text: Persicaria inhales deeply.

units.rawText: That's all I needed to hear.
units.displayText: That's all I needed to hear.

spans.text: That's all I needed to hear.

units.rawText: So you said the Oasis needed our help? We've got a bunch of agents who can fight with us. What do you need from us?
units.displayText: So you said the Oasis needed our help? We've got a bunch of agents who can fight with us. What do you need from us?

spans.text: So you said the Oasis needed our help? We've got a bunch of agents who can fight with us. What do you need from us?

units.rawText: The Oasis is under attack from the Entropics, both inside and outside. Zone G's Sandbox Barrier received heavy damage from the initial railgun impact and is now a focal point of attack for the Entropics.
units.displayText: The Oasis is under attack from the Entropics, both inside and outside. Zone G's Sandbox Barrier received heavy damage from the initial railgun impact and is now a focal point of attack for the Entropics.

spans.text: The Oasis is under attack from the Entropics, both inside and outside. Zone G's Sandbox Barrier received heavy damage from the initial railgun impact and is now a focal point of attack for the Entropics.

units.rawText: Magnhilda and Horizon are heading the defense, but they're about to give out.
units.displayText: Magnhilda and Horizon are heading the defense, but they're about to give out.

spans.text: Magnhilda and Horizon are heading the defense, but they're about to give out.

units.rawText: Zone G is in the general direction towards Rossum, right? That's right on our way back, then.
units.displayText: Zone G is in the general direction towards Rossum, right? That's right on our way back, then.

spans.text: Zone G is in the general direction towards Rossum, right? That's right on our way back, then.

units.rawText: I got it! Leave those Entropics to us!
units.displayText: I got it! Leave those Entropics to us!

spans.text: I got it! Leave those Entropics to us!

units.rawText: Be careful, Sol. There's an as-yet-unknown variety of Entropic commanding them, similar in appearance to a jellyfish. It will be a tough battle.
units.displayText: Be careful, Sol. There's an as-yet-unknown variety of Entropic commanding them, similar in appearance to a jellyfish. It will be a tough battle.

spans.text: Be careful, Sol. There's an as-yet-unknown variety of Entropic commanding them, similar in appearance to a jellyfish. It will be a tough battle.

units.rawText: This Entropic has the ability to consume operands en masse, and its methods of attack are unknown.
units.displayText: This Entropic has the ability to consume operands en masse, and its methods of attack are unknown.

spans.text: This Entropic has the ability to consume operands en masse, and its methods of attack are unknown.

units.rawText: Oh, don't worry so much, Persicaria. I don't really get it, but we just have to get rid of that jellyfish, right?
units.displayText: Oh, don't worry so much, Persicaria. I don't really get it, but we just have to get rid of that jellyfish, right?

spans.text: Oh, don't worry so much, Persicaria. I don't really get it, but we just have to get rid of that jellyfish, right?

units.rawText: And we've got Anna here, she's a professional! Right, Anna?
units.displayText: And we've got Anna here, she's a professional! Right, Anna?

spans.text: And we've got Anna here, she's a professional! Right, Anna?

units.rawText: Yes. I did mean to correct you before. It's Antonina.
units.displayText: Yes. I did mean to correct you before. It's Antonina.

spans.text: Yes. I did mean to correct you before. It's Antonina.

units.rawText: Antonina...
units.displayText: Antonina...

spans.text: Antonina...

units.rawText: Let's cut the chatter. I've not been idle while communications were down. Hannah and Turing have sent me the data from THOR.
units.displayText: Let's cut the chatter. I've not been idle while communications were down. Hannah and Turing have sent me the data from THOR.

spans.text: Let's cut the chatter. I've not been idle while communications were down. Hannah and Turing have sent me the data from THOR.

units.rawText: I've managed to approximate the state of damage to the Sandbox Barrier in Zone G. Here are a few proposals for repairing and rebooting the barrier, all simulated under the conditions of minimum available operands.
units.displayText: I've managed to approximate the state of damage to the Sandbox Barrier in Zone G. Here are a few proposals for repairing and rebooting the barrier, all simulated under the conditions of minimum available operands.

spans.text: I've managed to approximate the state of damage to the Sandbox Barrier in Zone G. Here are a few proposals for repairing and rebooting the barrier, all simulated under the conditions of minimum available operands.

units.rawText: Horizon is responsible for the repair work, yes? I'll send these plans through to her; it might help out. The specifics will have to wait until I arrive, of course...
units.displayText: Horizon is responsible for the repair work, yes? I'll send these plans through to her; it might help out. The specifics will have to wait until I arrive, of course...

spans.text: Horizon is responsible for the repair work, yes? I'll send these plans through to her; it might help out. The specifics will have to wait until I arrive, of course...

units.rawText: ...Don't give me those eyes, Persicaria. You're making it hard for me to continue.
units.displayText: ...Don't give me those eyes, Persicaria. You're making it hard for me to continue.

spans.text: ...Don't give me those eyes, Persicaria. You're making it hard for me to continue.

units.rawText: Hehe, didn't I say Anna was reliable? Relax, Persicaria. Prof said to trust your companions, too, right?
units.displayText: Hehe, didn't I say Anna was reliable? Relax, Persicaria. Prof said to trust your companions, too, right?

spans.text: Hehe, didn't I say Anna was reliable? Relax, Persicaria. Prof said to trust your companions, too, right?

units.rawText: Just leave it to us.
units.displayText: Just leave it to us.

spans.text: Just leave it to us.

units.rawText: ...Alright!
units.displayText: ...Alright!

spans.text: ...Alright!

units.rawText: As she looks at the two familiar faces, the uncertainties that lingered above her due to the Professor's absence dissipated in a flash.
units.displayText: As she looks at the two familiar faces, the uncertainties that lingered above her due to the Professor's absence dissipated in a flash.

spans.text: As she looks at the two familiar faces, the uncertainties that lingered above her due to the Professor's absence dissipated in a flash.

units.rawText: Persicaria thinks back to an occasion long ago, where Sol raised her spirits with that selfsame smile.
units.displayText: Persicaria thinks back to an occasion long ago, where Sol raised her spirits with that selfsame smile.

spans.text: Persicaria thinks back to an occasion long ago, where Sol raised her spirits with that selfsame smile.

units.rawText: We'll handle the Entropics outside the sector. You take care of the enemies inside.
units.displayText: We'll handle the Entropics outside the sector. You take care of the enemies inside.

spans.text: We'll handle the Entropics outside the sector. You take care of the enemies inside.

units.rawText: When we get back, everything'll be fine.
units.displayText: When we get back, everything'll be fine.

spans.text: When we get back, everything'll be fine.

units.rawText: Sol, Antonina, thank you.
units.displayText: Sol, Antonina, thank you.

spans.text: Sol, Antonina, thank you.

units.rawText: Daiyan... commit all reinforcements to—
units.displayText: Daiyan... commit all reinforcements to—

spans.text: Daiyan... commit all reinforcements to—

units.rawText: Are you alright? The wounds on...
units.displayText: Are you alright? The wounds on...

spans.text: Are you alright? The wounds on...

units.rawText: It's a long story, but don't you worry! It might look bad, but it's been treated already.
units.displayText: It's a long story, but don't you worry! It might look bad, but it's been treated already.

spans.text: It's a long story, but don't you worry! It might look bad, but it's been treated already.
